title: The long way home
setting: A short personal monologue, the kind you might hear at the start of a neighborhood podcast.
situationZh: 一段像播客开头的独白：有人错过换乘，决定走路回家。

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: So I missed my transfer by, I don't know, maybe forty seconds.
lines.spoken: So I missed my transfer by, I dunno, maybe forty seconds.
lines.meaningZh: 我错过换乘大概就差四十秒，我也说不准。

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: I saw the train doors close, and I just stood there.
lines.spoken: I saw the train doors close, and I just stood there.
lines.meaningZh: 我看着车门关上，人就站在那儿。

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: And I was gonna wait for the next one, but it was one of those nights where the app says twelve minutes and you don't really believe it.
lines.spoken: And I was gonna wait for the next one, but it was one of those nights where the app says twelve minutes and you don't really believe it.
lines.meaningZh: 我本来要等下一班，可那种晚上，应用显示十二分钟，你其实不怎么信。

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: It's not even that far — maybe a mile and a half — but it was cold, and I had these headphones in.
lines.spoken: It's not even that far — maybe a mile and a half — but it was cold, and I had these headphones in.
lines.meaningZh: 其实不算远，大概一英里半，可是很冷，我戴着耳机。

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: And I actually... I kind of liked it.
lines.spoken: And I actually... I kinda liked it.
lines.meaningZh: 而且说真的……我有点喜欢这样。

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: Nobody needed anything from me for twenty minutes.
lines.spoken: Nobody needed anything from me for twenty minutes.
lines.meaningZh: 有二十分钟，没有人需要我做什么。

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.meaningZh: 我知道这听起来不算什么。

lines.speaker: jordan
lines.text: But I got home and I thought, I should miss my train more often.
lines.spoken: But I got home and I thought, I should miss my train more often.
lines.meaningZh: 可我到家以后想，我应该多错过几次车。

gist.askZh: 后来她做了什么，感觉如何？
gist.askEn: What did she do after, and how did she feel?

details.askZh: 应用上显示下一班要多久？
details.askEn: How long did the app say the next one would take?

glue.noteZh: going to 在口语里是 gonna，前面的 was 又很短，整段常被听成 I wasgonna wait。
kind of 缩成 kinda，d 几乎没有，liked it 的 t 也常常丢掉。

chunks.form: I was gonna wait for the next one.
chunks.sayAfter: I was gonna wait, but I started walking instead.
I actually kind of liked it.

chunks.meaningZh: 我知道这听起来不算什么。
chunks.sayAfter: I know that sounds small, but it wasn't.

roleplay.setupZh: 朋友问你昨晚怎么回去的。你错过了换乘，选择走路，而且意外地觉得这段路还不错。
roleplay.aiRole: Maya, a friend who asked how you got home. She listens, maybe teases you gently, and may say she would have waited.
variants: You actually waited and it was 25 minutes.
You ran into someone you knew.
starters: I was gonna wait, but I started walking.
I actually kind of liked it.

fluency.promptZh: 用自己的话讲昨晚错过换乘、走路回家的事，以及你事后怎么想。准备 15 秒，然后说 60 秒，再更短、更快地说两遍。
fluency.promptEn: Tell the story of missing your transfer and walking home, and how you felt about it. Prep 15 seconds, then speak for 60, then 45, then 30.
